The rose window on the front above the portal measures 9.6 meters in diameter. The twin towers are 69 meters in height. With the claire-voie surrounding it, the south rose in the transept has a total diameter of 19 meters (62 ft). It was given to the cathedral by King Louis IX of France, known as Saint Louis.
The choir area was built from 1163 to 1177 CE.
